parsed.name: EPICS 标量计数通道配置组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于 synApps/EPICS 的标量计数记录中管理各计数通道。它主要按 EPICS 通道名称进行名称匹配与通道筛选，方便在实验中整理并选择需要采集的计数信号。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for managing channels in a synApps/EPICS scaler record. It is mainly used to match channel names and select channels based on EPICS naming, helping experiments organize and choose which counting signals to acquire.

actions.description: 按 EPICS 通道名称批量匹配多个计数通道。
actions.description_en: Match multiple counting channels in bulk using their EPICS channel names.

actions.description: 根据给定的 EPICS 通道名称选择要使用的计数通道。
actions.description_en: Select counting channels to use based on the given EPICS channel names.

actions.description: 匹配单个计数通道的 EPICS 名称。
actions.description_en: Match the EPICS name of a single counting channel.
